retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic layout featuring a central embossed script logo paired with ultra-wide tracked hairline sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A sophisticated, low-contrast composition defined by a single matte color where depth is created through simulated embossing and debossing of a central script element, framed by extremely thin, widely spaced sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic color harmony between background and graphic elements
Contrast between fluid, thick-stroke script and rigid, hairline sans-serif
Depth created by light and shadow rather than color variation
Extreme horizontal expansion of header text against a centered focal point
coreInvariants: Simulated 3D embossing effect on the central graphic
Ultra-wide letter spacing for secondary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, stylized script logo is centered, occupying the middle third of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central embossed script acts as the primary anchor, utilizing shadow and highlight to define form.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the wide-tracked top header, drops to the central embossed graphic, and settles on the lower-right secondary text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space around the central element emphasizes the minimalist, tactile aesthetic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Subtle highlights and shadows defining the embossed edges
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Hairline white or light grey for the fine-line typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, mid-to-low value range with minimal tonal variance.

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses hairline strokes with extreme tracking (approx 500-800 units)
Central logo uses a thick, multi-line script with rounded terminals
Secondary text uses a light weight sans-serif with standard tracking
characterSpecificRedesigns: The central script features parallel internal lines to simulate a 3D ribbon effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between ultra-thin geometric sans and thick, tactile organic script.

preserve: Hairline weight of the top text
Embossed effect of the center logo
avoid: Drop shadows that aren't part of the emboss effect

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hairline geometric structure of the display text.
Required for the central tactile element.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid matte charcoal grey background with a large, centered, embossed script logo that appears to be pressed out of the paper material.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add hairline sans-serif text at the top with extreme tracking and a smaller sans-serif subtitle in the bottom right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic?
Does the central logo have a 3D embossed appearance?
Is the top text weight hairline with very wide spacing?
Is the background texture matte and uniform?

mustRedesign: Standard weight fonts for the header
Flat 2D rendering of the central logo

mustAchieve: Subtle light/shadow interaction on the embossed logo
Perfectly uniform hairline strokes for sans-serif text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the top text is lowercase and spans the width.
Ensure the embossed logo is the same color as the background.
Verify that the secondary text is positioned in the lower right.
Confirm no gradients are used other than those creating the emboss effect.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a monochromatic matte finish + central embossed script + hairline wide-tracked header.
